juce.verified: 2026-09-04: tracktion_engine 0e02f70 pins modules/juce at exactly this commit

protobuf.note: C++ runtime and protoc for the engine, built from the submodule; the engine's CMake generates song.proto and render.proto at build time (ADR 0008 §4, pinned 2026-09-06). The last line before abseil, and what Ubuntu 24.04 packages. Added in M1 PR 5 as a new dependency, pending sign-off (CLAUDE.md #4).

abseil.note: grpc's own third_party/abseil-cpp, pinned by the grpc commit above as juce is pinned by tracktion_engine's. Not a separate submodule of ours. sfizz-ui vendors abseil of the same LTS release inside its own ExternalProject, which is a separate CMake tree, so the two never meet.

grpc.note: grpc++ for the engine's Render and Preview services at M2 (ADR 0013 §1). Chosen as the NEWEST release whose own third_party/protobuf submodule is f0dc78d7e6e331b8c6bb2d5283e06aa26883ca7c — byte for byte the `protobuf` entry above — so gRPC's protobuf and ours are one pin rather than two that must agree. v1.52.2 and earlier pin v21.9; v1.55.0 pins protobuf 22.x, where abseil becomes protobuf's own dependency and ADR 0008 §4's reason for the v21.12 pin stops holding. Verified 2026-09-07: configured and built libgrpc++.a and grpc_cpp_plugin against engine/vendor/protobuf itself under -march=x86-64 -mtune=generic -ffp-contract=off (1345 targets, 2m53s on 20 jobs), emitting no -ffast-math, no second -march, and only the -maes/-msse4.1 on abseil's randen that engine/cmake/check_flags.cmake already allows. NOT yet verified, and PR 0 settles both before PR 9: that it coexists with the engine's existing add_subdirectory(vendor/protobuf) in one tree, and what it costs on a two-core runner. Approved as a dependency under CLAUDE.md #4. Inert until PR 9 adds it to tests/renders.rs's COMPONENTS and the engine job's component list.

rubberband.note: time-stretch (GPL-2.0-or-later; compatible with this repository's AGPL-3.0 through the 'or later'). Options pinned in full by ADR 0011 §3: all twelve groups written out, which comes to OptionEngineFiner | OptionThreadingNever with the other ten at their zero defaults. Vendored 2026-09-07 in M1 PR 8 as a submodule, built from upstream's single/RubberBandSingle.cpp — one source file that hard-defines USE_BUILTIN_FFT and USE_BQRESAMPLER, so the FFT is not chosen from what the build machine has installed, and NO_THREADING, so ADR 0009 §3's single thread is compiled in as well as requested (ADR 0009 §4).

sfizz.note: library and JACK client only; this repo builds no VST3 (spike, 2026-09-04). The bundled plugin is sfizz_ui, and this entry documents what sfizz_ui vendors rather than a submodule of ours. Verified 2026-09-06 (M1 PR 6): sfizz-ui 6ef7b89 pins its `library` submodule at exactly this commit, so the two agree and sfizz_ui governs.

sfizz_ui.note: the sfizz VST3, and the submodule the engine builds. Added at M1 (ADR 0010); the `sfizz` pin alone builds none. Vendored 2026-09-06 in M1 PR 6, with surge_xt and dexed.

airwindows.note: deferred to M4 with clap-wrapper: an effect set, and its pinned repo may not build a Linux VST3 (ADR 0003 §4 amended, ADR 0010 §5).

app._note: app/'s direct dependencies, enumerated by exact version the way `schema` is, with the tree's integrity hashes in app/package-lock.json (docs/specs.md §17, registry packages). Signed off as ONE set under CLAUDE.md #4 (ADR 0016 §2); anything beyond this list goes back to a person before it is installed. Deliberately absent, each with its cost written out in ADR 0016 §3: any state library, any test framework, any CSS or component framework, and @vitejs/plugin-react. No app.* package can reach a render, so §17's golden-render pass is vacuous here and says so rather than being skipped (ADR 0016 §4). Written 2026-09-07 in M2 PR 1; nothing installs from it until PR 2 writes app/package.json.

tauri.note: one Rust crate and two npm packages on separate version lines. The webview Tauri renders in — WebKitGTK, WKWebView, WebView2 — ships with the operating system and cannot be pinned by anyone (ADR 0016 §5).

vite.note: the one build dependency. React ships CommonJS and bare specifiers do not resolve in a browser, so tsc plus an import map is more configuration than a bundler, not less.

codemirror.note: no consumer until M4's code views (ADR 0003 §8). Pinned now anyway: it replaces `"6.x"`, which was not a pin and would have re-resolved silently on the first install.

_reused.note: already pinned under `schema.typescript`; app/ is a new consumer, not a new dependency. @bufbuild/protobuf is the runtime the generated TypeScript imports; tsx runs the projection golden under node:test (ADR 0012 §5).

notes: commit: null means the tag hash must be resolved and filled in when the dependency is first vendored.
JUCE is never upgraded independently of tracktion_engine.

Any change here requires an ADR, and a full golden-render pass if the pin can reach a render; a pin that cannot says why in its ADR rather than skipping in silence (docs/specs.md §17, last rule; ADR 0016 §4).
bundled_plugins resolved from upstream git on 2026-09-05 (ADR 0010); date is the commit's own date. sfizz_ui is a new entry, not a re-pin.
app and engine.grpc added 2026-09-07 in M2 PR 1 (ADR 0013 §1, ADR 0016). The frontend set is one sign-off; the golden-render pass is required of any pin that can reach a render, and app.* cannot.

schema._note: Build-time codegen for schema/*.proto; none of it ships in the built product. Registry packages are pinned by exact version per docs/specs.md §17, with integrity hashes in Cargo.lock, package-lock.json and uv.lock.

betterproto2_compiler.note: runtime and compiler minor versions must match; pre-1.0, pin exactly

tool_api._note: The M0.3 tool API: the SongTools gRPC service and the MCP server (ADR 0006). Unlike `schema`, these ship in the built product; §17's registry-package rule covers them, with integrity hashes in Cargo.lock.

tonic_prost.note: requires prost ^0.14 and tonic ^0.14.6; tonic 0.13 pairs with prost 0.13 and would put a second prost::Message in the tree, which the generated Song would not satisfy

prost_types.note: direct dependency of the proto crate for FileDescriptorSet decoding; already present transitively via pbjson-types

sha2.note: content hashing for `add_asset` (M1 PR 3, ADR 0011): core hashes what enters the project. The engine hashes its own output, the PCM, with juce::SHA256 from the JUCE already pinned — the spike's note that it need not was about dependency count, and juce_cryptography adds none (ADR 0009 §2, settled 2026-09-06)

protoc_gen_tonic.note: codegen plugin, cargo install; requires protoc-gen-prost ^0.5.0, which is the pinned one. Rejects the btree_map option, which is prost's business anyway. The CI cache key in .github/workflows/checks.yml names the plugin set and changed with it

ci._note: GitHub Actions used by .github/workflows/. Build-time only; pinned by major version per the registry-package rule in docs/specs.md §17.

node.note: major pin; lock.baseline.json schema.typescript.node records the local 25.6.1

golden_render._note: What every M1 golden render is valid for (ADR 0009 §1, §5). ubuntu-latest moves, and every golden would drift with no PR to blame, so the engine and render jobs name the image explicitly.
golden_render.flags: -march=x86-64 -mtune=generic -ffp-contract=off on every vendored source, the three bundled plugins included; no -ffast-math and no second -march, checked against compile_commands.json by engine/cmake/check_flags.cmake before the engine and each plugin compiles (ADR 0009 §3; baseline chosen in M1 PR 5, extended to the plugins in PR 6, where the guard fired on sfizz's own -ffast-math and the flag was removed rather than the guard weakened)
